posts.name: Kane CLI
posts.tagline: Natural language browser & mobile app tests from terminal
posts.description: An agentic quality verifier for developers and AI coding agents. Describe a test in natural language, and Kane CLI runs it in a real Chrome browser and returns pass or fail with shareable proof. No selectors to write. Local-first, free to start.

posts.name: Nuphos
posts.tagline: The AI-Native DevOps Workspace.
posts.description: Nuphos gives engineering teams a shared environment where AI agents can learn your infrastructure, investigate issues, and operate production systems.

posts.name: Ito
posts.tagline: AI code review that runs your code
posts.description: Ito is an AI code review tool that runs your app before it reviews the code. For every pull request, Ito spins up an ephemeral environment, validates impacted flows, and returns runtime evidence so teams can catch bugs that static analysis and model-only reviewers miss. Instead of guessing from diffs, Ito shows what actually broke, where it happened, and why it matters before the PR reaches production.

posts.name: Scrimba Explain
posts.tagline: Ask any question, get a video back instantly
posts.description: Scrimba Explain generates a narrated video tutorial about almost anything you ask, instantly. You can upload files, add links, paste code, or just write what you’re trying to understand. It's MUCH faster than any of the video generation models, as we utilise our DOM-based playback technology. The video explainer can include images, code walkthroughs, animations, diagrams, and other visual aids, plus voiceover, captions and cursor so it feels more like YouTube than traditional chatbot UX.

posts.name: Oasis
posts.tagline: Where humans and agents come to work.
posts.description: An intelligent workspace for you, all your agents, and your team. Bring the best agents from across the ecosystem into one place, where people and agents work together as equal teammates. Every conversation, decision, and artifact becomes shared knowledge that compounds over time. As the workspace learns how you work, it adapts to your needs and builds specialized tools that help everyone do its best work.

posts.name: Human Behavior
posts.tagline: Product analytics told you what happened. We handle it.
posts.description: Dashboards are where insights go to die. Human Behavior closes the loop: 1) Collect. Our SDK captures your events, errors, and session replays. 2) Understand. AI watches every replay, catching rage clicks, dead buttons, and silent give-ups. 3) Act. Background agents email the customer, update Linear and your CRM, and open PRs with the replay as evidence. 4) Loop. Agents check the results and keep the product improving — on its own. No dashboard to babysit. It all lives in Slack or SMS.

posts.name: Skilldocs
posts.tagline: Figma for markdown
posts.description: Open a skill, and everyone is in it at once - real cursors, inline comments, and an editor that renders as you type. Then hand the whole conversation + diff back to the agent.

posts.name: Kitbitz
posts.tagline: 2K+ free hand-drawn illustrations for your projects, CC0
posts.description: A free CC0 library of 2,000+ hand-drawn assets across 13 themed kits. Download individual SVGs and PNGs, or grab the full Figma Community libraries with reusable components, color variables and flexible, resizable assets. Use them for games, apps, maps, illustrations and playful little worlds. We’re also building a Figma plugin, MCP support and world-building tools around the library.

posts.name: Caveman
posts.tagline: why use many token when few do trick
posts.description: One command wraps Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and more with a local proxy that compresses logs, tool output, and files before every provider call. In a pinned 54-run benchmark: 33.2% fewer input tokens with 18/18 correctness checks. Caveman can also run any existing agent skill with ~70% fewer tokens by loading text as images. Built on an open-source ecosystem with 97K+ GitHub stars.

posts.name: Mem Agent
posts.tagline: The AI that refuses to let you drop the ball
posts.description: An important deliverable, or a pizza place saved for that someday trip to Italy—Mem Agent keeps track of what you tell it, plus the todos living inside your notes and meetings, sharply following up so it actually happens. And with Push-to-Remember, seamlessly capture a thought into Mem or recall something you saved with a single button—all without leaving your work.

posts.name: Google Pixel 11
posts.tagline: Your most personal Pixel yet
posts.description: Discover the Google Pixel 11 lineup featuring updated camera hardware, the Tensor G6 chip, LED HiLight notifications and faster Gemini AI support.

posts.name: Qencode MCP
posts.tagline: Let AI agents transcode and process video
posts.description: Qencode lets AI assistants transcode, analyze, edit, optimize, and deliver video using natural language, powered by a cloud video processing platform.

posts.name: Coarena by Coasty
posts.tagline: The arena where agents battle on real-world work
posts.description: Coarena lets AI agents compete on real computer tasks, not synthetic benchmarks. Watch multiple models complete the same workflow side by side, compare speed, accuracy, and reliability, then vote for the winner. Discover which agent actually performs best on everyday work across browsers, apps, and enterprise software.

posts.name: WebBrain
posts.tagline: The sidebar agent for the rest of us
posts.description: Your browser, your models, your data. WebBrain is a free, open-source AI browser agent for Chromium browsers and Firefox. Run it locally with llama.cpp and most queries cost nothing — your data never leaves your device. It reads pages, extracts data, and automates tasks right from the sidebar. Prefer the cloud? Bring your own API key for OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, or 100+ OpenAI-compatible providers. Multilingual UI, token-conscious screenshots. MIT licensed.

posts.name: FluidDocs CLI
posts.tagline: Publish interactive docs that answer and report back
posts.description: FluidDocs CLI turns your prompts into interactive documents that answer questions and report back. You see who opened it, how far they got, and what they asked. Pitch decks, proposals, reports, board updates. One line installs the CLI and one command publishes. Edit later by prompt, and the same link updates. Viewer-side AI-enabled Q&A and analytics come built in.

posts.name: Insta360 X6
posts.tagline: A 360 camera, gimbal, and 3D scanner in one
posts.description: Insta360 X6 is a flagship 8K 360 camera with dual 1/1.1" Sony sensors, 8K50 video, 10-bit color, 140 minutes of 8K30 recording, and built-in storage. Its new PanoMind model and AI Director can find highlights, choose angles, and turn 360 footage into ready-to-share clips.

posts.name: Patience
posts.tagline: The only mechanic is waiting. The only currency is time.
posts.description: A minimalist iOS game where the entire mechanic is waiting. A circle appears on a black screen after an unpredictable delay — tap it in time, or restart from Level 1. Global leaderboard and a particle visualization built from every 100ms you spent waiting.

posts.name: Pickle Browser
posts.tagline: Browser for your agent. Runs local in a window you can see
posts.description: Watch your AI agent browse the web in real time. Pickle runs on your machine, using your real logins, with every action policy gated and logged as it happens. It compresses pages before your agent sees them, cutting token use by 32x. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and Codex CLI.

posts.name: Kin Health
posts.tagline: Record doctor visits and get clear summaries
posts.description: Kin helps you prepare for healthcare appointments, capture the conversation, and follow through afterward so you can stay present during the visit instead of taking notes or trying to remember everything later. After each visit, Kin turns the conversation into a focused summary. Rather than giving you a word-for-word transcript, Kin organizes the key points, recommendations, and next steps so you can quickly understand what happened and what to do next.

posts.name: Execlave
posts.tagline: The gate between your AI agents and the real world
posts.description: Execlave is an AI Agent Governance and Enforcement platform (runtime AMP) that sits between autonomous agents and your real systems, enforcing policy before every action instead of after incidents. It gives platform and security teams runtime policy enforcement, kill switches, and audit-ready trails so every agent action is authorized, traceable, and compliant with SOC 2, EU AI Act, ISO 27001, and other enterprise frameworks.

posts.name: apra-fleet
posts.tagline: Run a fleet of AI agents across your machines
posts.description: An open-source MCP server that turns machines you already own into a fleet of AI agents. Mix Claude, Antigravity, Codex, Copilot, and local models via OpenCode; route work by cost tier; run durable, multi-hour, observable workflows. It builds its self autonomously.

posts.name: Chiplab
posts.tagline: Test firmware on a virtual chip with no hardware needed
posts.description: Chiplab lets AI coding agents build, run, and test embedded software on a virtual copy of the real chip. No physical board required. Just connect it over MCP to any AI coding agent (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, and more), and skip hardware entirely. Chiplab compiles, runs, and debugs your firmware, and tells you exactly what broke. Works today on STM32 and Nordic chips, with more on the way. Currently in beta and we'd love your feedback.

posts.name: AIO.GEO Protocol
posts.tagline: Audit AI search structure. Dry run fixes. Receipts.
posts.description: AI Search Readiness: measure structure, ship dry-run fix packs, rescore, seal with HMAC receipts. SEO tests if humans can find you on Google. AIO.GEO tests if AI agents can do business with you.

posts.name: Phinq
posts.tagline: Stops AI agents before they break something
posts.description: Phinq is an open source runtime governance layer for AI agents. It intercepts every agent tool call, classifies it by risk, lets safe actions pass, holds irreversible actions for human approval, and records each decision in a tamper-evident hash-chained audit log.

posts.name: Dishylink
posts.tagline: Open-source Starlink monitoring app for Mac, Windows and Web
posts.description: Starlink's own app is phone-only, and the old web portal was switched off in 2024 with nothing to replace it. Dishylink brings that back as a native desktop app. It reads your dish and router over your own network. Features include: live stats, alignment in degrees, a 3D satellite view, obstruction time lapse, per-device data usage, power draw with daily and monthly history, and alerts that clear themselves. It's free, open source, no account, no cloud, and works on macOS, Windows and browsers.

posts.name: Kivicube
posts.tagline: Create AR experiences with AI, no code required!
posts.description: Create immersive AR experiences with AI, no code required. Meet Kivicube AR Agent, a new way to create WebAR experiences with natural language. Simply describe what you want and let AI bring your ideas to life. Create interactive elements, animations, UI, and experience pages with simple prompts. You can also use Kivicube’s visual editor for full creative control. Start with a template or your own assets. Customize your experience with powerful AR interactions in just a few clicks!

posts.name: ThreadPort
posts.tagline: Move AI chats between ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini in one click
posts.description: Every AI is good at different things — but your conversation is trapped in one. ThreadPort transfers the chat you're in right now to another AI with full context. No servers, no account, works in the EU. Free for 10 transfers/month. Chrome & Edge.

posts.name: Sequel
posts.tagline: Connect your marketing stack to Claude, Cursor or Codex
posts.description: Connect marketing, product, and finance data to any AI agent. Sequel learns every metric definition, edge case, and convention from your team.

posts.name: Interactive card messages for chat
posts.tagline: Design custom message cards for your chat experience
posts.description: Turn chat messages into interactive experiences. Build booking confirmations, approval requests, appointment cards, payment prompts, and more as native message cards inside your chat UI. Design them visually with Card Builder or send through CometChat’s API, and the UI Kit renders them automatically across your app. Every button tap is routed back to your code, so you stay in control without building custom message UIs from scratch.

posts.name: CLEO AI
posts.tagline: Launch-ready campaigns with relevant creators in 90s
posts.description: Generate a launch-ready LinkedIn influencer campaign in 90 seconds from your product URL. CLEO AI gives you the direction, creator shortlist, expected reach, storylines, and custom briefs you need to reach audiences in India.

posts.name: Kindmemo
posts.tagline: A private memory for the people you care about
posts.description: Kindmemo remembers the little things about your friends and family — birthdays, gift ideas, what they said last time — and shows you the right detail before you meet or message them. Local-first, no account, no subscription. $1.99 once, iPhone.

posts.name: Lucky Dangle
posts.tagline: A lucky charm for your Mac
posts.description: Lucky Dangle brings lucky charms from around the world to your Mac. Pick a charm (a nazar, a daruma, a maneki-neko, a nimbu-mirchi, or any emoji) and hang it from the top of your screen. It sways on real rope physics. Clicks pass straight through it. A shortcut drops it in when you need it, before a deploy, a demo, an interview. No AI, no account, no subscription, nothing collected. Pay once, and new charms arrive in free updates.

posts.name: Open Analytics
posts.tagline: Open-source web analytics for you and your AI agents
posts.description: Open Analytics is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics, built for humans and AI agents. Track real-time visitors, funnels, and revenue with one lightweight, cookieless script. Connect your analytics to AI tools via MCP, use our cloud, or self-host. GDPR-compliant with no consent banner.

posts.name: Tood
posts.tagline: A to-do list app for MacOS
posts.description: Tood is a native Mac app: sticky notes that live right on your desktop. Download for free.

posts.name: Design systems for vibe coding
posts.tagline: 100+ free design systems for any AI code or design tool
posts.description: Prompting your way to the perfect aesthetic for your app is a great way to burn time and tokens. With this library, you can simply choose a design system, remix it to your liking, and export it in a format tailor-made for your AI design or code tool. All completely free and without ever using a single token.

posts.name: Corelim
posts.tagline: The operating system for growing fashion brands
posts.description: Corelim gives independent and growing fashion brands one connected workspace to manage collections, products, SKUs, suppliers, files, costing, tasks and production. Instead of stitching together spreadsheets, email, WhatsApp and cloud folders, teams keep every product’s operational context in one place. Controlled shared links also let suppliers and freelancers access exactly what they need, without creating an account.

posts.name: RestifEye
posts.tagline: Break reminders that keep you fit
posts.description: RestifEye reminds you to rest your eyes and move your body at healthy intervals. Every break shows an animated exercise - eye movements, neck stretches, shoulder rolls, or full-body moves - matched to your intensity setting. It detects when you're in a call and waits. It notices when you've already stepped away and credits you the break. It warns 30 seconds before taking your screen. It tracks your screen time and break patterns locally, with weekly advice. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry.

posts.name: Cardixx
posts.tagline: One app for your business card, network, and events
posts.description: Do you use a printed, digital or NFC business card? Great, but what happens next? A card only matters when you have someone worth exchanging it with. That’s where Cardixx is different. It doesn’t just digitize your card; it takes you through the networking journey: build your card, check in, discover professionals nearby and connect. Cardixx turns a business card into a networking tool. With Cardixx, more connections, more opportunities.

posts.name: Tooltrace
posts.tagline: Automagically trace your tools an create custom organizers
posts.description: Tooltrace turns photos of your tools into gridfinity designs or laser cut foam patterns. Create 5S foam inserts and shadow boards to organize like never before

posts.name: Park With Us - Road Trip Planner
posts.tagline: From dream trip to booked campsites in 60 seconds
posts.description: Describe your dream road trip in plain English - dates, route, what matters to you - and get a full itinerary with scenic stops and real, bookable campgrounds along the way. Free, no account needed. Built by Park With Us.

posts.name: LangBlitz - Vocabulary Builder
posts.tagline: Build your vocabulary, one powerful word at a time
posts.description: LangBlitz starts with flashcards to learn new words, then builds lasting recall through quizzes and active practice. Its Vocabulary World provides an interactive way to explore a broad range of words across topics, difficulty levels, meanings, and related vocabulary, making discovery more engaging. The app is designed to work fully offline, so you can learn, revise, explore, and take quizzes anywhere, even without an internet connection.

posts.name: CaseLearn
posts.tagline: Learn with Real world Case studies
posts.description: CaseLearn — Real-world corporate strategies decoded for students

posts.name: SARA
posts.tagline: Open-source WhatsApp AI agent - 20 industry-specific brains
posts.description: Open-source WhatsApp AI agent with 20 industry-specific brains. Self-host with Docker or use the cloud. AGPL-3.0. - Release v1.0.0 — First stable release · Alessandro114/sara. SARA is a self-hostable AI agent for WhatsApp that understands your industry. 20 verticals — restaurants, clinics, real estate, salons and more. Function calling with 30+ tools. RAG. Multi-language. Free LLM providers (Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova). Works out of the box with Docker Compose.

posts.name: fline
posts.tagline: Your agent ships the repo. We build it and run it.
posts.description: Connect your coding agent over MCP and it ships your repo. fline writes the Dockerfile and the compose, picks the ports, provisions managed Postgres or Valkey, and hands back a URL already serving. The work happens outside your agent's context, so the deploy does not eat the session you were using to build. Secret values never pass through the agent: it declares the variable names, gets a link, and hands it to you unopened. Private beta, one node, and a maintained list of what does not work.

posts.name: GenOverview
posts.tagline: See where Google’s AI mentions you — and your competitors
posts.description: GenOverview tracks which Google AI Overviews cite your domain, shows where competitors get mentioned and you don’t, and tells you what content to write to close the gap. Free during our beta — no credit card, live in 3 minutes.

posts.name: SheetMergy
posts.tagline: Automate document generation from any spreadsheet or API
posts.description: SheetMergy automates document generation from your data. Connect Google Sheets, Excel, or any API — set up a template in Google Docs or Word — and generate hundreds of personalized invoices, certificates, contracts, or reports in seconds. Unlike basic mail merge tools, SheetMergy supports multiple sheet tabs, advanced filtering, grouping by date or value, scheduled automation, full run history, and built-in email delivery. Set it up once and it runs on its own every month.

posts.name: Grow or No Grow?
posts.tagline: Test your product sense on real experiments
posts.description: Fifteen real product experiments. Two versions each. Call which one shipped, get your score, then see the receipts. Built for founders, PMs, designers, and growth teams who want to know whether their instinct beats chance.

posts.name: Marksy
posts.tagline: Your bookmarks, auto-organized by AI.
posts.description: Save bookmarks, and let AI group them by topic automatically. Export back to Chrome as neatly organized folders in one click. No tags, no manual sorting, no clutter. Try your first month of Marksy Pro for just $1.

posts.name: Contexxt
posts.tagline: Give your AI tools your full design system to build with
posts.description: Contexxt turns your design system into rich, detailed context for your AI coding tools. Through one MCP, Claude, Cursor and Copilot get your whole system, every token, component and rule and how it's used, so they can build new things that actually fit your design system instead of guessing. That's far more than a raw Figma connection gives them. And once the code is written, Contexxt checks it against that same system too.

posts.name: Nearbase
posts.tagline: Affordable managed Postgres in Asia
posts.description: Nearbase is an affordable, fully managed PostgreSQL service tailored for Asia. We provide dedicated data center coverage in regional cities that traditional managed database providers typically ignore. Get reliable, fully managed instances at a much lower cost than major RDS providers.

posts.name: Sterk Find
posts.tagline: Turn product search into a conversation
posts.description: Sterk Find turns product search into a guided conversation. Its AI co-shopper asks shoppers thoughtful questions, understands their needs, and recommends relevant products while fitting seamlessly into your store’s brand and theme. Help customers move from “I’m not sure what I need” to a confident choice.

posts.name: Helix: Athlete Recovery Tracker
posts.tagline: WHOOP-grade recovery on the Apple Watch you already own
posts.description: Helix reads your Apple Health data and returns one recovery score every morning, a strain ceiling for the day, and fatigue tracked muscle by muscle. Bloodwork, VO2max testing and an AI coach on top.

posts.name: RUNR8
posts.tagline: Track AI spend, ownership and ROI in one place
posts.description: RUNR8 gives finance and operations one accountable view of AI spend. Connect multiple providers and billing files, then map costs to teams, owners and business use cases. Track targets and outcomes, compare spend with results, and create finance-ready reports showing what to scale, fix or stop. Billing data stays traceable, estimated figures stay labelled, and prompts are never collected.

posts.name: Laravel SaaS Starter
posts.tagline: Stop vibe coding from scratch. Ship your SaaS in one day.
posts.description: Don't vibe code every new project from scratch. Use a starter and work on the important things only - with tested features already working.

posts.name: Alete
posts.tagline: Agent that helps you think better
posts.description: What if you are the model? Algorithmic feeds don't just deliver content—they fine-tune your attention through outrage and clickbait. Alete is your cognitive lens for the digital age. Available as a native iOS & Mac app and browser extension, Alete runs on your device to process web pages in real-time. It strips layout noise, exposes narrative spin, and reveals the structural blueprint of what you consume. See before you think and own your attention.

posts.name: BlastRadius
posts.tagline: Speed up Java CI by skipping unaffected tests safely.
posts.description: Stop running your entire 45-minute test suite for a 2-line code change. BlastRadius uses a precise Java agent to map exact runtime dependencies, dropping your CI test times by 45% to 71% with zero flakiness heuristics.

posts.name: PM2Hub
posts.tagline: A calm desktop command center for PM2 processes
posts.description: PM2Hub is a local desktop app for managing PM2 processes. Start, stop, restart, inspect logs, and monitor CPU, memory, uptime, and restarts from one focused workspace. Free for up to two processes.

posts.name: Viko
posts.tagline: Free video editor that runs entirely in your browser
posts.description: Viko is a free, open source video editor that runs entirely in your browser. Unlike cloud-based editors, it processes everything locally with ffmpeg.wasm - your footage never leaves your device. It offers a frame-precise multi-track timeline with keyframe animation, color grading, chroma key, and captions, and fully offline MP4 export. No downloads, no accounts, no subscriptions, no watermarks. Projects and media stay in IndexedDB, making Viko the privacy-first choice for creators.

posts.name: Resume Screener by Agents-Kart
posts.tagline: Turn resumes into ranked, verified candidate insights
posts.description: Resume Screener goes beyond keyword matching — it actually verifies what candidates claim. It parses resumes, pulls up their GitHub profiles and live project links, and checks whether the code, contributions, and deployed work back up what's on paper. Education credentials get evaluated too, so you're not just trusting a bullet point. The result: a ranked shortlist built on verified skills and real project evidence, not just resume keywords.

posts.name: NaturalCam
posts.tagline: One Bayer RAW frame. No Smart HDR, no Deep Fusion.
posts.description: NaturalCam takes one Bayer RAW frame from one locked physical lens and develops it with Apple's processing switched off — no Smart HDR, no Deep Fusion, no sharpening, no noise reduction. The untouched RAW is always kept, so any shot can be redeveloped later. Nine looks, visible live in the viewfinder. Long exposure built from real one-second frames, since iOS won't hold a shutter open past one. Free on TestFlight — iOS 18, any iPhone with a Bayer RAW rear camera.

posts.name: Coolorea
posts.tagline: Free printable coloring pages for kids, by category
posts.description: Coolorea is a free catalog of black-and-white colorng pages for kids, organized by category. Browse, pik a drawing, download or print it instantly — no sigup needed. Hundreds of pages and growing. Content isin Spanish, built for parents, teachers, and kids.

posts.name: Photobook Studio
posts.tagline: Get your photos off the internet into a book
posts.description: Upload your photos, we lay them out, print them on a real press and bind the book by hand. Softcover from $24 to leather-bound cotton rag. One honest price — we never run a fake sale.

posts.name: By Faro
posts.tagline: See if AI agents can find, understand, and buy from you
posts.description: By Faro scores whether AI agents can find, understand, and transact with your site, not just crawl it. Checks API readiness, structured data, documentation, and pricing clarity most SEO tools ignore. Free 30-second scan.

posts.name: Verceltics 2.0
posts.tagline: Your whole web stack. One native iOS workspace.
posts.description: Verceltics 2.0 transforms the original Vercel analytics companion into a native iPhone and iPad workspace for your entire web stack. Connect 27 services across hosting, registrars, analytics, search, performance, and uptime. Manage deployments, domains, DNS, reports, and provider tools without opening a laptop. Credentials stay in your device Keychain, and requests go directly to official provider APIs. Open source, with no credential proxy or provider-data telemetry.

posts.name: CapAnything
posts.tagline: Capture any component. Caption it instantly.
posts.description: CapAnything is an open-source Chrome extension that lets you capture specific DOM elements with pixel-perfect precision. With built-in AI, you can instantly turn your screenshots into engaging posts for 7 social platforms in 18 languages.

posts.name: NaturalCam
posts.tagline: One Bayer RAW frame. No Smart HDR, no Deep Fusion.
posts.description: NaturalCam takes one Bayer RAW frame from one locked physical lens and develops it with Apple's processing switched off — no Smart HDR, no Deep Fusion, no sharpening, no noise reduction. The untouched RAW is always kept, so any shot can be redeveloped later. Nine looks, visible live in the viewfinder. Long exposure built from real one-second frames, since iOS won't hold a shutter open past one. Free on TestFlight — iOS 18, any iPhone with a Bayer RAW rear camera.

posts.name: Trace: AI & Tech News in Every New Tab
posts.tagline: Catch up on AI and tech whenever you open a tab
posts.description: Trace turns every new tab into a calm, personalized feed of AI and technology news. It gathers stories from trusted publications, groups coverage of the same event, and gives you concise summaries and key takeaways. Filter by topic, save stories for later, share useful finds, or open the original reporting. No noisy dashboard or endless scrolling. Just the important stories whenever you open a new tab.

posts.name: Sagewright
posts.tagline: Self-hosted control plane for your fleet of coding agents
posts.description: A self-hosted control plane for a fleet of coding agents. Spawn as many as you need, each in its own container, from any browser or your phone. Plug and play any harness or LLM — no vendor lock-in. Your context, your configuration, your infra: capability accumulates as an org asset instead of scattering across laptops and vendor CLIs. Own it, scale it, steer it live.

posts.name: ouracli
posts.tagline: Ask your AI about your sleep, readiness, and HRV
posts.description: One binary that is both a CLI and an MCP server for the Oura Ring API v2. Give Claude or any agent read access to your sleep, readiness, HRV, and workouts. Secrets stay in your OS keyring. Try it with zero credentials using Oura's public sandbox.

posts.name: Down Is Forever
posts.tagline: One-touch endless faller. Dodge, collect Echoes, go deeper.
posts.description: Down Is Forever is a one-touch endless falling arcade set in a dark mindscape. Hold left or right to steer the shaft, dodge hazards, bank Echoes, and chase Daily Descent on the leaderboard—plus story cases that unlock as you go deeper. What stands out: offline-first play, no ads, no forced online, and a Descent Protocol framing that makes every run feel like digging for a root memory. Free on Google Play; iOS coming soon. Every case has a truth. No mind has a floor.

posts.name: Complete Travel Planning Toolkit
posts.tagline: AI trip planner — itineraries, packing lists, budgets
posts.description: WanderAI builds a real day-by-day itinerary, a personalized packing list, a realistic trip budget, and local tips — for any destination. What stands out: it doesn't book anything or lock you into a platform. It just plans, so you can still book flights and hotels wherever you already trust. One-time $14.99, no subscription. Powered by Claude AI.

posts.name: The Life Dashboard
posts.tagline: Your family's day, always on the wall
posts.description: A touchscreen on the fridge that a local AI agent keeps current: today's schedule, the weather, the one email that actually needs you, the week ahead, family photos. The agent lives on the same Raspberry Pi, has its own phone number, texts you before meetings, and answers when you text back. It runs on your existing ChatGPT account.

posts.name: VipInbox x402
posts.tagline: Paid email for humans and AI agents
posts.description: VipInbox is now x402-enabled: a paywalled inbox where people pay by checkout and AI agents pay programmatically to reach you. Set a price, whitelist trusted senders, and get paid 85% in USDC when a message is worth delivering.

posts.name: Yamitext
posts.tagline: AI content generator for solo founders and indie hackers
posts.description: Generate SEO-optimized blog posts, product descriptions, and web copy in seconds with YamiText. The AI content tool built for WordPress sites and solo creators.

posts.name: FairClause
posts.tagline: AI contract review for freelancers
posts.description: Free freelance contract review in your browser. AI contract review flags IP grabs, non competes and unlimited revisions, with counter-language ready to send.

posts.name: Smart Networking
posts.tagline: The networking app for fast offline link and contact sharing
posts.description: Online, sharing a link takes one click. Offline it falls apart. Every link you own in one place—products, projects, contacts—each a QR code with one-tap copy. Installs like a native app on iOS & Android and works offline. No login, open source.

posts.name: Yard Studio
posts.tagline: AI landscape design with real plants
posts.description: Yard Studio is an AI landscape design tool that turns a photo of your outdoor space into realistic garden concepts and tailored plant lists. It uses real plants matched to your location, climate, sunlight and soil, so designs are grounded in what can actually thrive. Upload a photo, choose a style and generate a design in minutes. Swap plants, change landscaping features or describe updates in plain English. Every design includes real, buyable plants. Free to try, with no sign-up required.

posts.name: justext
posts.tagline: Yes. Another social network. This one is typography-first.
posts.description: YES. ANOTHER SOCIAL NETWORK. Nobody really needs another one. But what if it had no photos, no avatars, no videos? Just text. Meet Justext, a typography-first social network. Choose your font, color, size and motion. Make your words look the way they feel. Post your thoughts, or join a room and talk in real time. Is it useful? Probably not. Is it fun? I think so.

posts.name: Linkfeed
posts.tagline: Your link in bio is your TikTok profile page 🤯
posts.description: Linkfeed is a free link in bio tool that mirrors your TikTok profile exactly (down to the view count). You set affiliate links on your feed thumbnails, and your users are directed to exactly where you want. No more lost conversions.

posts.name: ChilliPopup
posts.tagline: Describe it, AI builds it - popups, games, forms & surveys
posts.description: ChilliPopup builds popups, forms, surveys, quizzes and four real prize games (spin wheel, scratch card, slot machine, claw machine). Describe a campaign in one sentence, let AI draft it, refine every block in a drag-and-drop editor, then publish to any site with a single line of code. The server decides game winners so odds can't be rigged, and every view, click and conversion lands in one dashboard.

posts.name: Yamitext
posts.tagline: AI content generator for solo founders and indie hackers
posts.description: Generate SEO-optimized blog posts, product descriptions, and web copy in seconds with YamiText. The AI content tool built for WordPress sites and solo creators.

posts.name: FairClause
posts.tagline: AI contract review for freelancers
posts.description: Free freelance contract review in your browser. AI contract review flags IP grabs, non competes and unlimited revisions, with counter-language ready to send.

posts.name: Verceltics 2.0
posts.tagline: Your whole web stack. One native iOS workspace.
posts.description: Verceltics 2.0 transforms the original Vercel analytics companion into a native iPhone and iPad workspace for your entire web stack. Connect 27 services across hosting, registrars, analytics, search, performance, and uptime. Manage deployments, domains, DNS, reports, and provider tools without opening a laptop. Credentials stay in your device Keychain, and requests go directly to official provider APIs. Open source, with no credential proxy or provider-data telemetry.

posts.name: Pentest Today
posts.tagline: Same day turnaround Pen Testing
posts.description: Boost your security posture with Pentest Today's same-day audit and reports for security assessments. We use agents and humans to test your endpoints quickly and thoroughly.

posts.name: Elephant
posts.tagline: Quota ends. Work doesn't.
posts.description: Elephant carries coding sessions between Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Gemini CLI, Pi, and other AI coding harnesses.

posts.name: Simple Health — AI Health
posts.tagline: Your health in plain words.
posts.description: Apple Health, minus the guesswork. Simple Health tells you what your numbers actually mean, in plain words, on your iPhone, Apple Watch, and home screen. Coming soon to the App Store.

posts.name: Upp
posts.tagline: Your personal active coach for every day.
posts.description: Upp is a gamified every day fitnes app, personalised for each user. It has all looksmaxing procedures in one place and it is designed to help users stick to their plan. App creates you a personalised plan according to your perferences.It is not just another passive tracker; it is active supproter trough every day.

posts.name: Free Paraphrase Tool
posts.tagline: Rewrite English text while preserving its meaning.
posts.description: Free paraphrase tool for English text. Rewrite with fresh wording, keep key details in view, and compare changes before you copy.

posts.name: Editing.video
posts.tagline: Free Online Video Editing. No Sign-Up. No Cloud Uploads.
posts.description: Edit videos online for free—no sign-up, software downloads, or cloud uploads. Trim, crop, resize, add text and audio, then export from your browser.

posts.name: Grid Maker
posts.tagline: Create a drawing-reference grid over an image.
posts.description: Grid Maker is a free browser tool for adding an adjustable grid to a reference image for drawing on paper, canvas, or a wall. Private and no account required.

posts.name: sheeplaunch
posts.tagline: launch product, earn points and redeem for more visibility.
posts.description: sheeplaunch is a product-launch and discovery platform for indie makers, startups, and creators. Launch your product, share what you’re building, collect honest feedback and votes, and find your first supporters. Discover useful new products, explore launches by category and popularity, and connect with the people building the future of the web.

posts.name: Maker Pocket
posts.tagline: Showcase What You Build
posts.description: Maker Pocket is a platform to discover and upvote the best tech products. Find top products launching daily.

posts.name: Launch Finds
posts.tagline: Discover newly launched products
posts.description: Launch Finds is a platform to discover and upvote the best tech products. Find top products launching daily.

posts.name: GTO Coach
posts.tagline: Master poker with solver-grade precision
posts.description: GTO Coach is a solver-grade poker training platform with a real CFR+ engine, precomputed GTO solutions for 8 formats, leak detection, and competitive arena. The affordable alternative to GTO Wizard — starting free. Master preflop ranges, postflop strategy, and exploit your leaks.

posts.name: Show2Build
posts.tagline: Don't just say you can build it. Show it.
posts.description: Show2Build is a marketplace where clients hire developers based on proof, not promises. Instead of reviewing portfolios and pitches, clients run a short timed build challenge — real developers submit real working code against real requirements — before picking who gets the job. Payments are staged through milestones with a held deposit, built-in dispute resolution, and secure Stripe Connect payouts, so both sides are protected from brief to delivery.

posts.name: Octen Model Gateway
posts.tagline: Every frontier model, plus fast web search, in one API call
posts.description: We built the fastest search on Earth, and then many devs asked if it could be AI-enabled search through our API too. Model Gateway is our answer, so you can use one key for GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more. And when you add one tool call line to the request, the model searches the live web, inside the same request, on an index that updates within 5 minutes of publication. Use one API key, get blazing fast AI search, and, for a limited time, we are giving 15% of your Model Gateway spend back!

posts.name: Runthesis
posts.tagline: Let's find your trading thesis
posts.description: Runthesis is a multi-agent LLM trading framework that mimics how a real trading firm works. Different AI agents split the job fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts gather market data, then bullish and bearish researchers debate it to keep things balanced. A trader agent makes the call, risk managers check it's safe, and a fund manager gives final approval before execution.

posts.name: YouTube Comment Picker
posts.tagline: Randomly pick a YouTube comment winner for fair giveaways.
posts.description: Use this YouTube comment picker to pick random winners from YouTube video or Shorts comments. Filter duplicates, keywords, dates, likes, and export winners.

posts.name: Tweetify
posts.tagline: Put your X on autopilot. Automate posts, threads and replies
posts.description: Draft posts and threads on iPhone and Android, choose an exact publish time, and manage your X content queue with Tweetify. Put your X on auto-pilot that posts, replies and post in threads while you sleep.

posts.name: World Coffee Note
posts.tagline: Rate the one-shop-only coffees you can't make at home
posts.description: World Coffee Note is where coffee lovers log and review signature coffees — the one-shop-only, recipe-specific pours you can't recreate at home. Every entry is tied to a real cafe, with honest ratings, translatable reviews, and community-maintained details.
